obligation_candidates.canon_label: Plans/Wiring_Matrix.schema.json currently has no fields for command-kind or normalization metadata.
exact_tokens: Plans/Wiring_Matrix.schema.json currently has no fields for command-kind or normalization metadata.

The wiring layer is still built around a simple command-binding contract (ui_element_id, ui_command_id, handler_location, expected_event_types) but it does not encode: wrapper normalization; deprecated alias mapping; route/open contract consumption; command classification such as shell_view versus navigation_wrapper.
Keep normalization metadata owned by the command-definition side, not by wiring rows.
Extend the wiring/gate model so it can consume catalog metadata for command_kind, normalization kind, canonical target contract.
notes: The matrix schema limitation and evidence schema limitation are different problems. Clean fix is catalog-owned normalization metadata consumed by wiring/gates.
